output.title: Notification fan-out
output.description: One shipping event fans out by customer preference to email, SMS and push queues, each sender respecting its provider's rate limit; failures dead-letter per channel and the senders sign in with a managed identity.

simulations.title: Holiday shipping wave
simulations.description: 2,000 parcels ship in five seconds. Email and push keep up; SMS queues behind its 50-a-second limit.

action.text: Every shipped parcel becomes one OrderShipped event. The router reads the customer's preferences and fans out to the channels they chose. Each dot is 10 events.
SMS is limited to 50 a second to stay inside the provider's throughput. Its queue grows while email and push keep pace.
The SMS queue drains at its own pace. Separate queues mean one slow channel never delays the others.

expectations.label: SMS queues behind its rate limit

simulations.title: SMS provider outage
simulations.description: Twilio errors for five seconds; the circuit breaker pauses SMS while email and push carry on.

action.text: Twilio starts returning errors. The circuit breaker opens and SMS sending pauses; messages wait in the queue instead of failing.
The breaker closes. The backlog drains at 50 a second; email and push never noticed.
